notes.title: Introducing "AI Confidential" from Narcosis' narrative team!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9759705/662eb4daff0cc1ecfe22da8dff08d8ff8a244042.png

And now for something completely different...: The writer and lead VO actor of Narcosis are set to spin-up an all-new, narrative-driven story set in a deceptively utopian future: AI Confidential.

Watch the trailer here, then read on for more info!

Artificial Intelligence, Real Problems.
You are Makenzy Turner, an affable RoboTechnician employed by AI megacorp, Indelligent Solutions. 
With your trusty assistant ARI, use high-tech tools and old-fashioned empathy to mend everything from broken parts to broken hearts.

Like Narcosis, AIC will feature an intricately-crafted narrative and top-notch VO performances... and may make you a little misty-eyed...
 
...Unlike Narcosis, the game features a cast of quirky, lovable characters to get to know (and - possibly - pull their plugs), a sprawling narrative packed with tough subjective choices and subversive humor, and... a unique and intuitive emoji-based conversation system. 

If this tickles your fancy, we hope you'll follow, like or wishlist and come along for the ride - we're still in the early stages (demo coming... soon!), but for now the future looks pretty damn bright...

All the links...:

 Steam page
 Twitter
 Instagram 
 Facebook
 LinkedIn

notes.title: [UPDATE] Anniversary edition delayed
notes.content:
Hi everyone.

Many of you reached out to us to point out that you couldn't find the anniversary DLC content that we've announced.

Following on that we found out that while our internal tests ran fine to update and access DLC, for a public release we needed an additional approval from Valve, which we're since waiting on.
It shouldn't take long, but in the meantime the DLC will remain inaccessible.

We'll keep you posted on that matter and tell you when the DLC is available as soon as it is up.

Apologies from all of us, hopefully that will get sorted out quickly.

notes.title: One Year Later: Major Content Update
notes.content:
Narcosis debuted one year ago today, so as a 'thank you' to all of you who've taken this journey with us — and those still to come — we've updated the Steam edition of the game with some very exciting extras...

First up: "Raptures of the Deep: A Journey into Narcosis," 15 ambient tracks inspired by our deep-sea survival story, including the eponymous closing theme from celebrated composer Akira Yamaoka (Silent Hill series). 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9759705/cf1b9e5a4a8823885b5d30800f1acbdf3b7467f1.png

Also included: "Hell or Highwater: Surviving Oceanova," survivor Kip Mattas' official, first-person account of the catastrophe that captivated the world's attention on the Feb 21, 2021. Previously available only via Amazon, it's now included with the game. 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9759705/657c64cef34558d21a647afcfd9c2dfbcae7038e.png

Finally, we've also included the entire accompanying radio interview with Mr. Mattas on Open Air, now downloadable for your on-the-go listening pleasure. 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9759705/2fda7d4f1d112053be0d8be114e96ab2a346969c.png 

For those of you interested in seeing how deep the game's narrative threads go, we hope you'll enjoy these 'supplementary materials,' which — in conjunction with the game, itself — comprise the "complete Narcosis experience."

Thanks again, and remember: if you've enjoyed your time with our debut title, we hope you'll take a moment to spread the word, or leave a review. Narcosis is a small fish in a mighty big sea, and your support makes a difference. 

Honor Code, Inc.

notes.title: (Difficulty) Update!
notes.content:
Greetings, dear divers...

Since Narcosis launched (nearly a year ago!) we've received quite a bit of praise, and not a few criticisms. In particular, there's one key level midway through the game that's a little less... explicit in its instructions, as to where to go, and how to get there. Those of you who've played it may remember the eighth level - fittingly called "FOLLOW PROCEDURE" - in which the Survivor finds himself (even more) lost and directionless, after an... unexpected encounter. 

Having read your feedback, and watched dozens of streams, we got the gang back together to try and make this particular section just a little bit easier. Narcosis is - at its dark heart - a survivor's story, and we hate to think that some of you might opt not to reach the (bitter? sweet?) conclusion, on account of some poor game balancing.  

If all that is too cryptic, a transcript of the change log is pasted below. Nothing too spoiler-y, but it's redacted, just in case...

Whether its your first time playing, or if you're going through again to try and uncover some of the  many, many secrets we've stashed deep beneath the sea, we hope you'll enjoy the journey, and share your thoughts with us.

Finally, the one-year anniversary of the game's release is approaching. With that in mind, we've got a few more exciting announcements incoming... So watch this space!

Change Log: 
[spoiler]
+ Changed start point
+ Changed blinking light depending of that new position (it disappears in the desert... That's normal)
+ Changed some fishes' paths
+ Added new trigger for spider in the desert
+ Added some path to go to the other side
+ Added anemones glowing in order to lure player to the other side
+ Changed a bit the slide of the volcanoes to better trap player
+ Made easier to climb the new way from the volcano to the exit[/spoiler]

notes.title: Narcosis is 33% off, and now with Oculus Touch support!
notes.content:
Want to cool down from the summer heat?

Now's the chance, enjoy the cold depths at 33% off during the Steam summer sales.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9759705/1e6e309da1c256080f6b7ed46770961c4ce02b5f.png

Occulus Touch Support

Adding to our support to VR platforms, we want to make sure that you can play on these with the associated input methods. 
Now, as we already discussed with some of you in the forums, we won't be able to support full motion controls, as that would require a significant amount of rework.

That said, you can now enjoy Narcosis using Oculus Touch controllers, with the following (for now) fixed control scheme : 

Stick (Left Touch)  : Movement
Stick (Right Touch) : Rotation
A (Right Touch) : Use/Menu validation
B (Right Touch) : Cancel
Y (Left Touch) : Recenter VR sensor
Trigger (Left Touch) : Knife
Trigger (Right Touch) : Flares
Grip (Any Touch) : Thruster
Menu key (L touch) : Menu


Vive controllers support is coming up as well, just need a bit more work. 

Changelist [v1.1.3.18535]

 Oculus Touch Support (see above)
 Fixed the achievements "Signs of Life" and "Memento Mori" that didn't trigger for some people. If you're among them, they should unlock once you launch the game with this new update. (Thanks to Altermind for helping out with this)
 Balanced a bit oxygen supplies in some levels.

notes.title: New Patch is Up (v1.1.2.18509)
notes.content:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9759705/fe343ed07bbaea900ee955e53aeb8fc40f06c8e3.png

Some players have noticed that another patch's gone live. Mostly "behind the scenes" stuff, but in the interest of transparency, here's what's changed:

Changelist [v1.1.2.18509] 

    Safe Zone decals updated upon level save
    Minor memory optimizations
    The "Wanderer effect" works when Vsync is "off" and running at a high framerate
    Japanese subtitles fixed
    "You're an engineer" VO subtitles fixed (all languages)
 Vertices adjusted in cafeteria so the "blood room" doors don't clip through walls
 Player-collider fixed on crane in training pool
 Fixed unclamped shader that occasionally causes a "white flash" 
 Interpolation added to the mist-on-glass effect (to prevent flashing in/out)
    Fixed continue button displaying "commence"
    Credits updated
    "Open Air" no longer unlocked prior to credits
    Cuttlefish attack angle adjusted in "Back to Normal"
    Main Menu options adjusted: now says "Continue" instead of "Start Over" upon reaching the final sequence

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9759705/ecca8b7f765e4e48572b33eaba88ee3287e8b69f.png

Subtitles in a few new languages are on the way, and future updates to address some of the most outstanding requests and criticisms are in the works; watch this space for updates.

Thanks for playing, and the warm reception to this survival story, set beneath the sea. If you like what we've done, please encourage others to #PlayNarcosis for themselves, or maybe leave a Steam review - every bit helps!

Have a great weekend, 

Honor Code

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9759705/d01b4dac41d2669b07a3c85ad7472eed03a18b64.png

notes.title: The Art of the Abyss + UPDATES
notes.content:
Narcosis is entering its second week, and continues to earn accolades for its unique setting, haunting ambience, and unique style of story-telling. We're working to address as many player issues as possible; an update just went live that includes: 

    ULTRA-WIDESCREEN SUPPORT
    Revised (English) post-mortem and relic text 
    Various bug fixes and "behind the scenes" design tweaks

Have you been enjoying Narcosis? Reached the bitter(sweet?) conclusion to our survivor's tale? Good or bad, we hope you'll share your thoughts, or consider leaving a review — as a small team just getting its start, every bit of encouragement, feedback or (constructive) criticism helps...

And now for something sweet, to savor this weekend...
Jeremy Briel runs a gaming blog dedicated to artistic, professional-looking screenshots of games. Officially and as a fan, he's captured and shared stunning shots of all sorts of games — ranging from uber-indie to AAA — including Abzu, Albino Lullaby, Bioshock, Caffeine, and Layers of Fear.  

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9759705/3d53093c88d6ab47b82b8b8a0f0babaa16fd9175.png

Jeremy reached out to us recently about putting his unique spin on Narcosis, and after one look at his prolific portfolio, we couldn't refuse. Some samples of his work are below; we'll be posting more from time to time here. If you like what you see, and have a few hours to spare, make sure to drop by his blog and lose yourself in his incredible work...

More at http://digitalfrontiers.tumblr.com

notes.title: Wow, what a week... [Collectibles, Updates and More]
notes.content:
Narcosis has shipped, and by and large players, streamers and press seem to enjoy our survivor's story, and the strange paths it takes...

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9759705/e134e812cce9f09400811824633412c316d0e4a1.png

A few updates:
Trading Cards, Badges and Emoticons are now online, and ready to be earned. Who'll be the first to collect all six cards...?

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9759705/9380ece5b034b07f9f2c716ca3d4f5f80319e31f.png http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9759705/d516df497e5e1a31326cac1c3a4d8e89422bc548.png http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9759705/6c9858c850c36b157787fd2a67675b84e12eb2f6.png http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9759705/c12c0aa782d59f11b21e6ff2621dc5f38d839c3d.png http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9759705/8ee0b5414680ed6d0d0e3867701356ca22c28427.png

We've made a few bug fixes, including:

    Invert Y-Axis now works w/mouse+keyboard
    Fixed flare trajectory offset
    Additional bug fixes and optimizations

Additional improvements - including ultra-wide support - are on the way...

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9759705/efaa5a04fef11ca5ca2f65b933b0d5f5ec49554c.png

We're so grateful for the warm response, and would love to hear your thoughts. Have you recovered all the ID tags? Unearthed all the 'relics'? If you've played through to the bitter end, please consider taking the time to leave an honest review, and let us know what your thoughts. For this first-time team, visibility is everything, and every bit helps...

notes.title: Narcosis Update - Other Indies Worth a Look
notes.content:
Development of Narcosis is humming along, and we'll be showing it off again at Unite '16 next week. In the meantime, all of us at Honor Code wanted to take a moment to give a shout out to some fellow indies you should be checking out.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9759705/44459e2a4fdbe0000b036e700dcbed1bdb99bc51.jpg

Through the Woods just released on Steam, and it's a non-traditional horror game (which we love, for obvious reasons). It's a "third-person Norse horror adventure set in a forest on the western shores of Norway that tells the story of a mother and her missing son." They pretty much had us at "Norse horror."

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9759705/a940b7f88c46b76521d6e8a2b7e53182207edf13.jpg

If you prefer the sub-nautical over the supernatural, you might want to check out Neptune Flux, a story-driven sci-fi game set beneath the sea, launching on November 15. One of the cool things about working independently is that you can reach out to other teams about swapping assets, and not have to worry about getting sued. If you end up checking it out, keep an eye out for a "blink and you'll miss it" reference to the Oceanova initiative (which plays a key role in Narcosis' narrative).

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9759705/873c6888a7a678e5a5358c6961efd9d700b00a6c.jpg

Finally, it appears we've been beaten to the "best breathless simulator" punch. We met the guys from Orthogonal Games (who also created The Novelist) a few weeks back at an Intel event, and were immediately impressed by their first-person arctic survival thriller Near Death. In the creators' words, it's "not a survival game, but instead a game about survival" — which is so clever, we kinda wish we'd written it first. It's available on Steam right now.

That's it for now. Don't forget to follow us via Facebook and Twitter, where we try and post (a little) more regularly.

Cheers!

-Honor Code Team

notes.title: Dispatches from the Depths: 9/28
notes.content:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9759705/c7ea4f4abeab33951129501de3a8f657d8e0bacf.png

Hi everyone,

to put it mildly, we haven't been as good as we should, about keeping in touch. But we're in the final stretches: the game's being refined rapidly, day by day, and we're looking forward to sharing more — and more frequent — updates with you (Including a trailer) in the weeks to come...

Lately, we've been asked a lot about a launch date. To be honest, we're reluctant to make more promises, as they're easily broken (Exhibit A: our trailer, which mentions a "2014 release"). 

But rest assured development continues 24/7 (literally: some of the team's based in the SF Bay Area, with the rest spread across  several cities in France), and we'll have news to share on this front soon. Most of us have been working on Narcosis for over three years — so we're determined to bring you something special.

If you're looking for even more frequent updates — or feel like helping us get the word out — we hope you'll join us on Facebook and/or Twitter.

Some recent developments: 

Our French team just wrapped up a three week workshop in Angoulême. We only see one another a few times a year, so it was a great chance to get together, and a lot accomplished. Pics here, if you're curious.
At the same time, we wrapped our second and final VO recording session — below's a photo of voice actor Jeff Mattas, and a mystery guest...
In addition to numerous visual and UX changes, here are some cool new features recently added to the game:
VFX: ink and blood, storms and particles... 
First-person animations: flare-launching, knife-swinging, object-collecting and... 
DYING.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9759705/fb63a1239041870ce72bd27031c0f280425470b7.png
